v0.1.0.description:
First release.

Craftmine AP lets you play Craftmine (`25w14craftmine`) in an Archipelago multiworld. Mine ingredients and skill-tree upgrades are shuffled into the multiworld, and unlocking ingredients, buying skill-tree nodes, advancements, special mines, Mine Crafter levels and hub doors send checks.

Files:

- `craftmineap-0.1.0.jar` is the Fabric mod. It needs Fabric Loader 0.16.14 or newer and Fabric API `0.119.10+25w14craftmine`.
- `craftmine.apworld` is the world for Archipelago 0.6.4 or newer.

Setup and the options are in the README.

It is singleplayer only. Not every check has been played through in a real game yet, so if something does not send or unlock, open an issue and attach your `latest.log`.
v0.1.0.title: v0.1.0

v0.2.0.description:
Sphere 1 had too many checks: 155 of 293 on default options. With this release it holds 58 to 83 of 299, depending on your starting tab.

Changes:

- New `upgrade_tabs` option, on by default. Each skill-tree tab now has its own item, and you can't buy that tab's upgrades until you have it. One random tab starts open. Upgrades you receive still work while their tab is closed.
- Nodes you can't buy yet get a red glow, and their tooltip names the tab item they need. The Tracker tab lists it too.
- School of Hard Knocks nodes are now checks, behind their own `School of Hard Knocks Tab` item. They have no items of their own, so buying them never applies their penalties.

Default seeds now have 299 checks, 6 more than before.

Files:

- `craftmineap-0.2.0.jar` is the Fabric mod. It needs Fabric Loader 0.16.14 or newer and Fabric API `0.119.10+25w14craftmine`.
- `craftmine.apworld` is the world for Archipelago 0.6.4 or newer.

Update both files together, since a seed generated with this apworld needs this mod. Seeds generated with 0.1.0 still work with the new mod, and they stay without tabs.

Setup and the options are in the README.
